create_euler_maruyama_predictor: create an EulerMaruyamaPredictor instance with an SDE and score function for stochastic sampling
create_reverse_diffusion_predictor: create a ReverseDiffusionPredictor instance with an SDE and score function for reverse diffusion sampling
